caption:
Do you log groceries in an app, or is that too much hassle? Tell us in the comments.

Snap your receipt, WE.LIFE reads the products and quantities, and you confirm. Your pantry matches your cupboards, and your meal plan and shopping list take it into account.

WE.LIFE is a Life OS for everyday life, and Food OS is its first module. The link to the free WE.LIFE beta is in our bio @welife.world. This is a beta (test) version.

Photo: AI-generated illustration.
